title: Working with the American Psychological Association on youth mental health and AI
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI and the American Psychological Association advance evidence-based guidance, resources, and safeguards for responsible AI use and youth mental health.
body:
## Advancing Responsible AI Use for Youth Mental Health
A significant collaboration has been established between OpenAI and the American Psychological Association to promote evidence-based guidance and resources for the responsible use of AI in relation to youth mental health. This partnership aims to develop and implement safeguards that ensure AI technologies are utilized in a way that supports the well-being of young individuals.

## Technology and Approach
The joint effort focuses on creating a framework that allows for the responsible integration of AI in mental health support systems for youth. By combining OpenAI's technological expertise with the American Psychological Association's understanding of psychological principles and youth mental health, the collaboration seeks to establish best practices for AI use in this critical area. This approach will help in mitigating potential risks associated with AI exposure and ensuring that these technologies contribute positively to mental health outcomes.

## Impact on Developers and Researchers
This initiative is crucial for developers and researchers working at the intersection of AI and mental health. By providing evidence-based guidance and resources, the collaboration will enable the creation of more effective and safe AI-powered tools for supporting youth mental health. This, in turn, will facilitate further research and development in the field, ultimately leading to better outcomes for young individuals and contributing to the advancement of responsible AI practices.
